# Axis Air Conditioning & Heating LLC

> Heating & air conditioning based in Copperas Cove, Texas. Axis Air Conditioning & Heating repairs and installs AC, heat pumps and mini-splits around Copperas Cove and Killeen. Reviewers say Kenneth finds the real problem fast and often shows up the same day.

## Services
- AC repair: Kenneth tracks down the actual problem, whether it's a blower fan or just a dirty filter.
- New systems & heat pumps: Rheem air handlers, condensers and heat pumps installed in attics and closets.
- Ductless mini-splits: Gree mini-splits for additions, rooms and townhomes that need their own cooling.
- Ductwork & new builds: Duct repair at existing homes and new duct runs and plenums for new construction.
- Maintenance & tune-ups: Filter changes, drain flushes and gauge checks, plus tips to keep the unit running.
- UV lights & air quality: UV germicidal lamps installed inside the air handler.

## About
Axis Air Conditioning & Heating LLC is a heating and air company near Copperas Cove, owned and run by Kenneth. He answers the phone and runs the service calls himself, and the company is a licensed Texas air conditioning contractor (TACLB79401C). Axis installs Rheem systems and Gree ductless mini-splits, repairs and builds ductwork, and adds UV lights to air handlers. Homeowners and property-management companies call Axis back for years: some customers who had systems installed in 2017 still use Kenneth for service.

## Frequently asked questions
- Q: How quickly can you get to Copperas Cove?
  A: Often the same day. One reviewer had Axis at the door within an hour of calling about a blower fan.
- Q: Do you install ductless mini-splits?
  A: Yes. Axis installs Gree mini-splits on brick homes, townhomes and additions, with wall heads inside.
- Q: Do you work with property managers?
  A: Yes. Property-management companies use Axis for their rentals as well as their own homes.
- Q: Are you licensed?
  A: Yes. Axis is a licensed Texas air conditioning contractor, TACLB79401C.
- Q: What brands do you install?
  A: Rheem air handlers and systems, and Gree ductless mini-splits.
